title: 3d–4f Decanuclear Coordination Cage Platform with Synergistic Catalytic Activity and Confined Selectivity for Bis(indolyl)methane Synthesis

synthesis.procedure: A mixture of H5L (30.4 mg, 0.0500 mmol) and triethylamine (16 μL, 0.22 mmol) was prepared in 4 mL of methanol and stirred for 10–15 min. Zn(ClO4)2·6H2O (18.6 mg, 0.0500 mmol) in 4 mL of methanol was added dropwise and the mixture was stirred at room temperature for 10 min to give a suspension. Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (22.2 mg, 0.0500 mmol) in 2 mL of ethanol was then added, affording a yellow-green clear solution. The mixture was stirred for 20 min, filtered, and left to crystallize at room temperature. After 3 weeks, light yellow crystals suitable for X-ray analysis were collected by filtration, washed three times with cold methanol, and dried in air. A 10-fold scale-up (0.500 mmol H5L) followed the same procedure in 40 mL methanol / 40 mL methanol / 20 mL ethanol and likewise gave light yellow crystals after 3 weeks (Scheme 2); PXRD matched the small-scale product.
synthesis.time: stirring 10–15 min (ligand/base) + 10 min after Zn salt + 20 min after Dy salt; crystallization 3 weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: solution mixing, filtration, and room-temperature crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered and crystallized at room temperature for 3 weeks; light yellow crystals collected by filtration, washed three times with cold methanol, and dried in air
synthesis.yield: 31.2 mg, 57% based on H5L (small scale); 224 mg, 41% based on H5L (0.5 mmol scale-up)

properties.summary: No magnetic or photoluminescence data are reported for the Zn4Dy6 cage; characterization and discussion focus on crystal structure and heterogeneous synergistic catalysis of Friedel–Crafts bis(indolyl)methane synthesis.
